subject: Training data pipeline for perception model
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded Mytra who was moving from simulation to real-world data collection to train their perception model. At the time they lacked a system to effectively index, auto-label and QA to keep up with the surging training data volume. I wonder if those are the challenges you've encountered at [COMPANY]? 

In case Encord is new to you - we help physical AI teams (e.g. Skydio, Zipline, Mytra, etc.) automate their annotation pipelines as they scale. Handful of customers in the space leverage our model-assisted workflow and our labelling editor's support across 2D (image & video) and 3D point cloud data, as a complement to Foxglove.

Keen to hear how you're thinking about your training data as you scale? I'm flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays if you're open to chat.

subject: Encord & [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Pretty cool to read up about the acquisition of Mirriad's - very impressive
to see the young AI company buying up the legacy player. We work
with Synthesia, Flawless, Captions and other content AI companies who
struggled with ensuring annotators actually label with care (rather than
rushing for incentives).

We've helped those teams navigate that balance ssing our data analytics
suite to identify the most valuable samples to label or review, and by
building QA workflows around HITL annotation - so high-impact samples get
high-quality labels, every time.

In case encord isn't familiar - we're a multimodal data curation and
annotation platform (Series B, $50m raised, 100+ FTEs).

Would love to set up a time to see if we can support you with any
challenges in your ML pipeline and introduce ourselves  - let me know if
you're free for a quick call and demo of our platform?

subject: Data to model performance feedback loop
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded Entrust (Onfido) who needed to understand failure modes and accelerate time to action to improve data representativeness & label inaccuracy, when the expected margin of error for model prediction is low. With injection attacks becoming more common in the IDV space, I thought solving for model accuracy in high-stake situations might be something on your mind? 

In case Encord is new to you - we support over 200 AI teams to accelerate the annotation to model eval feedback loop. They typically leverage our workflow orchestrator for annotation (auto-labeling, consensus, and human QC/QA) which is integrated with our data and label validation capabilities. We've also built out functionalities around data lineage tracking and secure deployment for teams in regulated environments. 

How are you thinking about the data to model performance feedback loop at [COMPANY]? I'm flexible Tuesday to Thursday if you're open to a chat.

subject: Encord & Athena
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congratulations on the merger with Sightline - excited to hear what's in
Athena's journey. We've recently started working with Anduril and Shield
AI's CV teams, who were facing challenges with curating edge case datasets
and tracking small objects on the horizon (often just a few pixels). I
wanted to check if you're encountering similar issues?

We're helping them improve dataset curation with embedding and similarity
search, and automating tracking with SAM2 and interpolation techniques for
smoother ML pipelines.

If Encord's new to you, we're a multimodal data curation and annotation
platform with a focus on video. We're Series B, have raised $50M, and now
have over 120 employees.

Would love to find time to introduce ourselves. Let me know if you're free
for a quick chat in the next few weeks.
